entities.summary: Malik Benjamin "Shake" Milton is an American professional basketball player for Partizan Belgrade of the Serbian League (KLS), the ABA League, and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball for Southern Methodist University (SMU) from 2015 to 2018. Milton was drafted 54th overall in the 2018 NBA draft by the Dallas Mavericks, and was then traded to the Philadelphia 76ers on draft night. He has also played for the Minnesota Timberwolves, Detroit Pistons, New York Knicks, Brooklyn Nets, and the Los Angeles Lakers.
